title: Moon ruins at 33° in the Disney-von Braun film

tellings.quote: In one extended scene, a team of astronauts travel to the far side of the moon for the first time. That's when a radar engineer yells out that some kind of radiation is being picked up on their sensors at 33°.

plain: In one of the space-exploration films Walt Disney made in the 1950s with the rocket engineer Wernher von Braun, astronauts reach the far side of the Moon for the first time and a radar engineer shouts that some kind of radiation is being picked up "at 33°", and the scene turns to ruins there. Jesse Michels describes the scene himself, treating the number 33 and the ruins as hidden signals in an official-looking film.
